title: Password Reset Not Working
content: If a user cannot reset their password: 1) Ask them to check spam/junk folder for the reset email. 2) Confirm the email on file matches their login email exactly. 3) Reset links expire after 30 minutes - send a fresh one. 4) If using SSO (Google/Microsoft login), password reset does not apply; direct them to reset via their SSO provider instead. 5) Clear browser cache or try incognito mode if the reset page does not load.

title: User Cannot Log In / Account Locked
content: Accounts lock automatically after 5 failed login attempts for security. To unlock: an admin must go to Settings > User Management > find the user > click Unlock Account. If the user is a first-time user, confirm their invite email was accepted. If login fails with 'invalid credentials' repeatedly, check for autofill issues or extra spaces in the email field.

title: Integration / API Sync Failing
content: When a third-party integration (CRM, payment gateway, calendar sync) fails: 1) Check API key validity in Settings > Integrations - keys expire after 90 days on some providers. 2) Check the integration status page for outages. 3) Look at recent webhook logs for error codes - 401 means auth failure (regenerate key), 429 means rate limit hit (retry after cooldown), 500 means the third-party service is down. 4) Re-authenticate the connection if the token was revoked.

title: Billing / Invoice Discrepancy
content: For billing complaints: 1) Pull the invoice history from the Billing tab. 2) Check if a plan change (upgrade/downgrade) happened mid-cycle, which causes prorated charges - this is expected behavior, explain proration clearly. 3) Duplicate charges are usually caused by a failed payment retry; verify with the payment processor logs before refunding. 4) Refunds beyond 14 days require manager approval - escalate to Billing team.

title: Page Loading Slowly / Performance Issue
content: For slow performance complaints: 1) Ask which browser and if it's up to date. 2) Ask approximate number of records/members in their workspace - large datasets (10,000+ records) can slow down list views; recommend using filters. 3) Check if the issue is specific to one page or the whole app. 4) If it's a widespread issue affecting many customers, this should be escalated immediately as a potential outage, not handled as a single ticket.

title: Data Export Not Working
content: If CSV/Excel export fails or is stuck: 1) Large exports (over 5,000 rows) are processed in the background and emailed when ready - this can take up to 15 minutes, it's not stuck. 2) Check that the user's email is verified, since export links are sent by email. 3) If it's been over 1 hour with no email, check server export logs for a failed job and manually trigger a re-export.
